correctness.rationale: Exhaustive independent forest tests for every nonempty vertex subset, deterministic acyclic discrete Morse matchings at six degree bounds, and global DAG verification establish the stage models. The only mixed model has signed integer Morse differential [[-1,-1,0],[-1,0,-1]], with unit rank-two minor, proving its S4 type. A signed 96-simplex 4-cycle in F1 and a signed 143-simplex 4-cocycle in F4 have unit pairing -1, verified against all required faces, proving integral persistence. The code and exact certificate are embedded and can be replayed. The claim is confined to this finite graph.
